answer: Participants stake a unique jade token minted per verified identity, locked for an epoch. To register, each agent must also contribute compute to a shared orchard of validation tasks, proving real work rather than spawning clones. Duplicate identities fracture stake across many wallets but still must fund each orchard task, so sybil cost scales linearly while honest agents amortize it. A dune-like drift of fake registrations gets pruned when unspent jade expires, making mass forgery economically irrational. The Agent0013 deployment anchors trust at HPhDKT2mD4.
